practices: Read the Gospel slowly enough to notice one command you can practice today.
Remember by name one living person and one departed person in prayer.
Perform one act of mercy without announcing it.
Before speaking in anger, repeat the Jesus Prayer once with attention.
Give thanks for three concrete gifts from the last twenty-four hours.
Take one honest step toward reconciliation where it is safe and possible.
Set aside five quiet minutes with no screen and no argument to win.
Offer useful work today as service rather than self-display.
Notice someone who is usually overlooked and treat them with dignity.
End the day by naming what needs repentance and what deserves gratitude.
